earlier_sources: https://github.com/googlefonts/googlefontdirectory-hg at 52f780bc9d197280a9f430574e179a5f233c56b6, ofl/imfelldoublepica/: the font as built and its metadata; src/ holds METADATA_comments.txt, no source.
disclose: The releases kern with a legacy `kern` table (4055 to 4248 pairs per style) and have no GPOS; these sources kern through a GPOS kern feature, which is how fontc builds kerning. HarfBuzz shapes every kerned pair alike in both (the functional gate). Decided 2026-10-01: releases with an old kern table are accepted and disclosed.
